statements.t: The outlook reflects the Company’s U.S. online direct-to-consumer business and is supported by a significantly expanded marketing budget for the fourth quarter.
At an expected gross margin of approximately 70%, the Company expects fourth quarter U.S. gross profit of approximately $10.5 million.

As a result, the Company expects U.S. daily sales to more than triple during the quarter, from $60,000 at its start to more than $200,000 by year-end, and expects active U.S. subscriptions to exceed 40,000 by year-end, more than four times current levels.
In the five days since our last update, active subscriptions grew 42% to 8,940 and their monthly value rose 44% to more than $1.3 million, which reinforces our confidence in the outlook.
We expect approximately $15 million in U.S. revenue and $10.5 million in gross profit for the quarter, with daily sales exceeding $200,000 and more than 40,000 active subscriptions by year-end.
We look forward to keeping investors updated on our progress in the weeks ahead.”

Furthermore, the Company has established R&D partnerships targeting major health disorders such as obesity, diabetes, and cancer, enhanced by artificial intelligence drug repurposing technologies, and focuses on the R&D of novel patented nutraceuticals, specialized root extracts, proprietary complex generics, and innovative OTC products.
There also may be other factors that we cannot anticipate or that are not described herein, generally because we do not currently perceive them to be material.

dropped.t: Full-year 2026 reflects the Company’s outlook, not results.

The Company currently expects the fourth quarter of 2026 to be the strongest quarter in its history, supported by contract manufacturing orders, seasonal strength in distribution and accelerating sales in the United States.
We are reaffirming our outlook to surpass $90 million in revenue this year, and we currently expect the fourth quarter to be the strongest in our history.”
The Company’s complete third-quarter results will be reported in its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the period ended September 30, 2026.
